protocol.mal_join_definition: Denominator is distinct valid explicit (source namespace,user,item) pairs before mapping or mixed-state exclusion; numerator has a unique canonical MAL_ID. Raw row-weighted and distinct-item joins are reported separately.
protocol.rating_definition: Known explicit rating normalized to integer 1–10; missing or zero is unrated and never a negative label. Source-specific scale and provenance must be evidenced.
protocol.release_year_definition: Use first-release date with source status aired/airing and upper cutoff at supported snapshot period; future/not-yet-aired and unknown dates are excluded from recent gates.
protocol.user_identity_policy: Count source profiles, not unique people. MAL usernames are one namespace; opaque mixed-platform numeric IDs need source-key provenance before cohort admission.
